user.title: Connect Haus cameras
user.description: In Haus, open any camera’s settings and choose Connect Home Assistant. Enter the one-time setup code. The default address works when Haus Helper runs on this Home Assistant host.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Haus cameras
reauth_confirm.description: Generate a new setup code in Haus to restore this camera-only connection.

error.invalid_auth: This setup code is invalid or expired. Generate a new code in Haus.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Haus Helper. Check the address, network and add-on version.

abort.already_configured: This Haus Helper is already connected.
